title: Control:Override
description:
Control:Override Is A Puzzle Game About Control. 

You play as a hacker who has hacked into a rogue AI to terminate it. 
Abuse Physics to solve puzzles.

Delve into a virtual cyberspace inside a rogue AI that YOU created in the past.

Break through the AI's security layers. 

Reach the core. 

Terminate the AI. 

But Should You?

 Key Features • Simple mechanics. Unexpected consequences.

• Physics defying puzzles.

• A generous rewind mechanic that lets you fix your mistakes. Problem solving is an iterative process.

• A minimalist neon art style.

• An intriguing story of a hacker who hacked an AI of his own creation.

• Multiple endings that form a jigsaw puzzle-like narrative.
description_short: Control:Override is a puzzle game where you must share control between the environment and yourself. Defy Physics. Solve puzzles . Terminate the rogue AI. And perhaps confront the truth about why it went rogue.
